title: Matching replies to requests
description:
Send requests with ids and match replies that come back in any order.

```
send #1 getUser, #2 getScore, #3 getUser
reply #2 -> getScore done (score 77)
reply #1 -> getUser done (ada)
reply #9 -> unknown id, ignored
#3 timed out after 500 ms
```
hints: Events from the server (not replies) need no id; give them a separate message type.
requirements: A map from request id to a pending entry (method, start time, callback).
Replies call the matching callback and remove the entry.
A `tick(now)` call times out entries older than the limit.
stretch: Let a callback send a new request, and make sure that does not break the loop over `m_pending`.
